# Lexi (ليكسي)

> Offline, local-first legal archive software for legal professionals in Morocco
> and North Africa. It stores an office's case files, reads Arabic and French
> documents, files them, and finds them again in an instant, on the office's own
> Windows machine, with no cloud, no account, and no internet connection after a
> one-time activation.

Site: https://lexiarchive.com (Arabic) · https://lexiarchive.com/fr/ (French)
Contact: contact@lexiarchive.com

## Who it is for

All legal professionals, not one profession:

- Lawyers · محامون · avocats
- Notaries and adouls · موثقون وعدول · notaires et adoul
- Legal consultants · مستشارون قانونيون · conseils juridiques
- Judicial commissioners · مفوضون قضائيون · commissaires de justice

Judicial commissioners are the segment the workflow was first built against, and
some features are specific to them (see "Commissioner-specific module" below).
They are not the only audience: the archive, the Arabic/French document reading
and the search serve any legal practice.

## What it does

- **Archive and search.** Every case in one place with its parties, dates and
  reference. Typing a name or a number finds the file in under a second, across
  an archive of thousands.
- **Reads the document for you.** Drop in a pleading or a judgment and Lexi
  extracts the parties, dates, court and reference. The user reviews and corrects
  before anything is saved. The software proposes, the professional decides.
- **Arabic and French throughout.** Interface, documents and generated files, in
  both languages. Arabic is right-to-left everywhere, not just translated.
- **Nothing leaves the machine.** No document is uploaded, no copy is kept by us,
  there is no account and no cloud. Backups are the office's own, to a disk it
  chooses.

## Commissioner-specific module

Genuinely specific to judicial commissioners, and presented as one module rather
than as the product: statutory acts (محاضر / actes and procès-verbaux) generated
from office-editable templates, and signification rounds (جولات التبليغ /
tournées de signification) planned by neighbourhood and recorded as dated
evidence of diligence. A lawyer will never run a tournée.

## Practical facts

- Platform: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. No server, no IT installation.
- Memory: 8 GB minimum. Disk: about 15 GB, of which ~9 GB is the optional
  document-reading component, downloaded after installation and skippable.
- Licensing: per machine, by licence key. Internet is required exactly once, at
  activation; the software runs fully offline afterwards.
- Price is not published on the site. A licence is requested through the form at
  https://lexiarchive.com/#request and answered by email.
- Languages: Arabic (primary) and French.
- Country: Morocco. Legal vocabulary is Moroccan practice.

## What Lexi is not

- Not a web app, not SaaS, and not cloud-hosted. There is nothing to log into.
- Not a case-management service that stores client data on a vendor's servers.
- Not available for macOS or Linux today. Windows only.
